display.methodZh: 2026-10-26 独立复测，实际请求并返回 LongCat-2.5-Preview；不证明 brief 中无 Preview 后缀的 LongCat-2.5 已发布，也不证明二者是同一固定权重。两档均显式传 thinking：enabled / disabled。请求 temperature=0，但官方文档规定服务端覆盖为开启1.0 / 关闭0.7；因此不能称确定性温度0对比。当前Chat Completion文档未列命名effort档位；另一个Responses接口列出low等参数但没有max名称，本组未混用不同协议。每次首轮上限12,288输出token、600秒，两个独立队列最多并发2，时延仅为本次本地客户端观测，不作模型速度排名。保留全部首轮与失败，隐藏思维内容不公开。
display.methodEn: Independent 2026-10-26 retest. Requested and returned model: LongCat-2.5-Preview; this does not establish release or checkpoint equivalence of the brief’s LongCat-2.5 name. Both groups explicitly request thinking enabled/disabled. temperature=0 is sent, but the vendor documents overriding it to 1.0 on / 0.7 off, so this is not a deterministic temperature-zero comparison. The Chat Completion documentation does not list named effort levels. A separate Responses API documents low and other levels, without a max name; those protocols are not mixed here. First attempts use 12,288 output tokens and a 600-second deadline. Up to two independent request queues overlap; local client latency is recorded without a speed ranking. All first attempts/failures are retained. Private reasoning content is omitted.
